headline: QUICK SPARK: Energy Overtakes Technology As 2026's Best Sector
summary: Energy has overtaken tech as 2026's best sector, up 29% as the Iran war lifts oil. XLE jumped 9% in July while XLK fell 6.8% on the chip rout.

headline: Chip Rebound Lifts Nasdaq 100, Micron Rallies 5%: Stock Market Today
summary: Growth and chip stocks led a mixed Wall Street tape Monday as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 rose while the Dow and small caps slipped.
